headline: Undrafted rookie QB Daniels savors Thursday night win vs. Cowboys
summary: Jalon Daniels became the first undrafted rookie starting QB in the common draft era to win a game for a team that entered winless, leading the Bucs to a 24-16 win over the Cowboys.

headline: After Jalon Daniels leads Bucs over Cowboys, NFL teams are 8-4 when starting a backup QB
summary: Injuries to starting quarterbacks have not derailed teams this season.
